drafts.text:
Google is now showing businesses how to get traffic from AI Search inside the dashboard.

Not just for big ecommerce brands.

If you run a trade shop, check:
Your site answers "near me" questions
Real job photos are up
Your service area is listed where Google can read it
drafts.pattern: News-jack of Google AI Search update, cut to a short checklist for trades (alexgroberman Google ecommerce AI Search post, ~8k views)
drafts.video_tip: Screen-record opening Google Search Console or Business Profile on phone, tap through category and service area. 12 seconds, vertical.
drafts.best_time_ct: Weekday 8-11 AM CT (weak prior signal from focus accounts; Tony has little history of his own yet)
drafts.link_reply: Optional reply: 'Want a second set of eyes on yours? stableafdesigns.com'

drafts.text:
100-amp vs 200-amp panel ⚡

100-amp was common in older homes. Fine for loads of that era.

200-amp is what most new builds and heavy upgrades use for an EV charger, bigger HVAC, or a workshop.

Depends on your loads, not the neighbor's.

Master electrician, Baton Rouge area.
drafts.pattern: Two-thing contrast headline with a plain answer (electric_4u Voltage ≠ Current style; today's big-number and contrast hooks still winning)
drafts.video_tip: Photo of a 100-amp panel next to a 200-amp panel, two labels. Or a 5-second clip of your sister pointing at the main breaker amperage stamp.
drafts.best_time_ct: Mid-morning or early afternoon CT so she can reply

drafts.text:
Storm season tip for South Louisiana:

If you lose power, do not backfeed a portable generator through a dryer outlet.

That can energize the lines outside your house and put linemen at risk.

Use a transfer switch or interlock kit installed by a licensed electrician.
drafts.pattern: Blunt safety advice in short sentences (sweatystartup plain-advice tone from today's ~37k post, applied to a real local tip)
drafts.video_tip: 10-second clip: sister on camera saying the backfeed line, then pointing at a transfer switch in a panel. Face plus gear builds trust.
drafts.best_time_ct: Mid-morning or early afternoon CT so she can reply
